title: Phase 6 pending publish preview DTO boundary cleanup
summary: Migrates pending publish preview DTO imports from the desktop compatibility export to the existing core DTO inventory owner and removes the matching temporary boundary allowlist rows.
reason: Phase 6 boundary cleanup is reducing remaining publish core-to-desktop imports in DTO-only slices while leaving pending manifest contracts, drain confidence cycles, recovery, and final placement behavior untouched.
behavior_before: Pending publish facade, result helpers, and row helpers referenced PendingPublishPreviewDto through mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, producing four allowlisted NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP findings across three import-statement groups.
behavior_after: Pending publish facade, result helpers, and row helpers reference PendingPublishPreviewDto from mediapipeline.core.kernel.dto_inventory while the desktop inventory DTO module remains a compatibility export; the three pending publish DTO allowlist rows are removed.
manual_validation: PASS: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe .\ops\scripts\dev\run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.check_dependency_boundaries --format json --report-only (hard_findings=52, allowlisted=52, unallowlisted=0, unused_allowlist=0, NO_CORE_TO_DESKTOP=35; domains: config=8, processes=9, publish=3, queue=6, schedule=1, status=8)
rollback_plan: Restore PendingPublishPreviewDto imports in pending facade, pending results, and pending rows to mediapipeline.desktop.application.dto_inventory, restore the three removed allowlist rows, refresh the three generated summaries, and mark AB-PUB-002, AB-PUB-008, AB-PUB-011, and AB-PUB-012 open again in the edge ledger.
